commits.summary: Stop tracking AL cache; fix .gitignore encoding
commits.details:
.gitignore was written as UTF-16LE with a BOM, so git read it as one
garbage pattern and the .vscode/.alcache/ rule never applied. Rewritten
as UTF-8, and the 10 already-tracked cache files removed from the index.
